releases.releaseName: Shing Live v1.2.1 - Companion Cat Meow Audio & 20s-30s Timer
releases.summary: Cats now reliably meow every 20s to 30s with cute audio sound effects, speech bubble, and hearts.
highlights: Cat Meow Interval: Configured cats to meow every 20s or 30s (20000ms - 30000ms)
Audio Sound Effect: Embedded authentic meow sound effect that plays whenever cats meow
Interactive Meowing: Clicking any companion cat triggers immediate meowing with floating hearts
Stream Trigger Integration: Cats meow and play sound on incoming gifts, follows, and chat messages
Dashboard Test Button: Added Test Cat Meow button in companion settings

releases.releaseName: Shing Studio v1.2.0 - Stream Sound Effects & 500 Gift Physics Jar
releases.summary: Full sound effects suite with MyInstants online search, local audio import, 500 gift physics jar, and support for all TikTok gift icons.
highlights: Full Sound Effects System: Alert sounds for Follows, Gifts, Big Gifts (1,000+ coins), and Likes with master volume control
MyInstants Online Search: Live search, instant audio preview, and one-click download with automatic alert assignment
Local Sound Import: Support for importing custom .mp3, .wav, .ogg, and .m4a audio files from local computer
All TikTok Gifts Display: Fixed gift icon visibility with catalog resolution and 3D shiny glass coin rendering
500 Gifts Jar Capacity: Increased default max gifts from 150 to 500 with smooth physics stacking
releases.notes: Major audio and gift visual upgrade for TikTok Live streamers.

releases.releaseName: Shing Studio v1.1.0 - Viewer Display Names & Coins HUD
releases.summary: Full viewer display name support, accurate TikTok coin currency HUD, and in-app update manager.
highlights: Viewer Display Names: Overlays now display viewers' customized nicknames instead of username handles
TikTok Coins Currency: Standardized all alert badges and jar physics from Diamonds to Coins
Chat Message Cap: Added configurable maximum visible messages limit (default: 8 messages)
6 Chibi Hair Styles: Twintails, Long, Bob, High Ponytail, Space Buns, Half-Up with custom color palettes
In-App Updater: Built-in update checker, one-click installer, and release notes history
Offline Live Mode: Graceful test mode simulation with gift catalog mappings
releases.notes: Recommended update for all TikTok Live streamers.

releases.summary: Initial release of Shing Studio for TikTok Live streamers.
highlights: Account verification modal with avatar and bio preview
Matter.js 2D physics glass jar overlay for TikTok gifts
Cute speech bubble chat overlay with animated avatar shapes
Pixel art chibi and cat companion interactive stage reactions
Multi-tier triggers and alert overlays for follows, gifts, and likes
Lower third animated banner for social links
Pastel purple theme with 6 customizable color themes
